{{Quote|Master Wyellett, your ordeal has ended. I only wish I'd heard you reaching out to me sooner.|Xerender|<ref name="Jedi Master on Ice">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Jedi Master on Ice|Hoth}}</ref>}}
'''Xerender''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Xerender was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wyellett]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], they dueled the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] together, and though the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] escaped, Wyellett stole Baras' [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and used it ever since, viewing it as a weapon of darkness brought into light. Eventually, Wyellett got captured and was to be delivered to Baras, but his prison ship was shot down over [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and both Baras and Xerender assumed he perished. In truth, Wyellett survived, but was trapped under meters of ice below the wreckage of the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]''. He survived for years subsisting only upon [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and eventually was able to reach out to Xerender and alert him of his presence. Xerender and his Padawan [[Sewlor]] mounted a rescue mission to Hoth, where they allied with the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] commandos led by [[Fetzellen]]. However, their actions antagonized Fetzellen's renegade soldier [[Broonmark]], who isolated and killed Xerender's Padawan.

[[File:Xerender_meets_Wyellett.png|left|thumb|Xerender is finally reunited with his master after years of separation]]
Meanwhile, Darth Baras learned of Xerender's activities on Hoth and [[Hunt for Xerender|sent]] his [[Empire's Wrath|Enforcer]] to chase him, believing that Xerender was searching for a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Xerender [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] his pursuer's holocommunications and interrupted the apprentice's report to Baras, which resulted in Baras lashing out and killing [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lanklyn]]. Xerender eventually made it to the ''Star of Coruscant'', but pursuit was hot on his tail, and Broonmark managed to kill Fetzellen, while the Sith took care of the remaining Talz commandos. Xerender finally found his old master, but their reunion was cut short by the Sith's arrival. Xerender dueled the apprentice of Darth Baras, but was defeated. In the end, Xerender and his old Master were buried together under tons of ice.
